video_title: 76ers... ASSEMBLE! KCP Talks 76ers Avengers, NBA Fails & Injury Updates | Dawg Talk EP58

quotes.speaker: Kiran Rehal
quotes.summary_phrase: High rate of injuries across the NBA this season
quotes.excerpt: 15% of the league is hurt right now.
quotes.quote: The first thing that I was thinking about this week that was crazy, and I guess even just since the season has started, do you know 15% of the league is hurt right now? It was Jalen Williams, Anthony Edwards, Kawhi Leonard, Jared Jackson Jr., Bonk Carroll, the list goes on and on. This is crazy.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on the severity of current NBA injuries
quotes.excerpt: I did not know Jaren Jackson Jr. tore his MCL.
quotes.quote: It is not small injuries. These are serious injuries that these guys are having. When I saw it, I did not know Jaren Jackson Jr. tore his MCL. I did not know that. I had to keep looking that up. I am like, damn, there is a lot that is going on.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas' critique on player preparation and injury prevention
quotes.excerpt: If you are not properly training and getting in shape, you are just letting them in their summer.
quotes.quote: What happens is, if you are not properly training and getting in shape, and you are just letting them in their summer, looking good, coming to the season, training camp, and then go out in the game and play against another superstar, that superstar is going to go 100 for the first time, and that is what is happening.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope's intense off-season training regimen
quotes.excerpt: My workout this summer was pretty hard. I haven't played since last year All-Star break.
quotes.quote: I mean, I cannot speak for everybody else, but my workout this summer was pretty hard. I haven't played since last year All-Star break, so my workout schedule was intense. I changed a lot of my eating habits, so a lot of my stuff was locked in, but I cannot speak for everybody else.

quotes.speaker: Kiran Rehal
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton's injury was a result of hard work
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Haliburton specifically, you know he was working this off-season.
quotes.quote: I feel like it could be a generalization. Maybe that is the case for some people, but like Tyrese Haliburton specifically, you know he was working this off-season. And it was his other leg. I feel like sometimes it is unfortunate situations.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Tyrese Haliburton's injury
quotes.excerpt: I think with Tyrese Haliburton's situation, he got to play back-to-backs where he is not ready yet.
quotes.quote: I think with Tyrese Haliburton's situation, he got to play back-to-backs where he is not ready yet. You are going to eventually get there, but I think just slow that down. Play as much as you can, but like when you do feel something, don't try to compensate because that is when you start to hurt other things.

quotes.speaker: Jordan McGruder
quotes.summary_phrase: Adidas' 65-game rule hints at player availability
quotes.excerpt: Adidas put out today where it was a campaign of essentially saying like 65 games.
quotes.quote: Did you guys see the commercial that Adidas put out today where it was a campaign of essentially saying like 65 games one way or another? Like kind of hinting that he is going to come back sooner than later and still be able to play at least 65.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on the uncertainty of knee surgery recovery
quotes.excerpt: It depends on his knee injury. They just said knee surgery.
quotes.quote: It depends on his knee injury. They just said knee surgery. So like it could be small, you know it could be big, you never know. Some people came back from like knee surgery and played. Not quick, but like they got back onto the court, but like it depends on what that surgery is. So no one knows. It just said knee surgery.

quotes.speaker: Jordan McGruder
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan McGruder's frustration with the 65-game rule
quotes.excerpt: I really don't like the 65-game rule either. Because if you are out here killing.
quotes.quote: I really don't like the 65-game rule either. Because if you are out here killing, so like Cade Cunningham killing him last year. Cade was killing last year, and he had a collapse long. And then like, yeah, you know he missed a good amount of time, but it is just like Cade was in that MVP race.

quotes.speaker: Kiran Rehal
quotes.summary_phrase: Cade Cunningham and Luka Doncic received exceptions for awards
quotes.excerpt: Cade Cunningham actually had an exception last year that was approved. Luka had the exception.
quotes.quote: Cade Cunningham actually had an exception last year that was approved. Luka had the exception. Anthony Edwards tried to get the exception, but it was denied. So like I even think about it in this situation now, I hope it doesn't ever come to a point where he is like kind of forcing himself to play and maybe it is not best for him because he wants to hit that 65.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope's advice on prioritizing long-term health
quotes.excerpt: Also don't hurt yourself for the coming season or the future trying to race for that.
quotes.quote: Also don't hurt yourself for the coming season or the future trying to race for that. Be healthy, get it next year. If you are already in that talk of like you got to get a certain amount of games to get a certain amount of money and I am the top guy, I know it is going to be there for me regardless. Okay, let me get healthy first.

quotes.speaker: Kiran Rehal
quotes.summary_phrase: Kiran Rehal on Yaxel Lendeborg's energy and confidence
quotes.excerpt: What are we thinking of his energy and confidence so far?
quotes.quote: I want to talk about one other rookie, Yaxel Lendeborg. What are we thinking of his energy and confidence so far? I am curious.

quotes.speaker: Kiran Rehal
quotes.summary_phrase: Kiran Rehal predicts Lakers will win against Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say the Lakers. I've watched a couple games.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say the Lakers. I've watched a couple games. The West Coast ones I ain't going to lie, those were kind of brutal. I'm feeling it the next day, but I've liked what I've seen so far. I don't think I have a lot on them, but Austin Reaves has been playing fantastic. Luka is being Luka.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope's defensive strategy against Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: If we're trapping both of them, get the ball out their hand. Somebody else got to score.
quotes.quote: If we're trapping both of them, get the ball out their hand. Somebody else got to score. Who whose hands are you going to put it in? If I'm the coach, that's what I'm doing. Every game, I'm trapping Luka. Both of them are not going to be on the floor at the same time every time. So we're trapping one of them. Let AR do all that. AR is not consistent like Luka, in my opinion.
